recipe.visualDefinition: A centered portrait of a blonde woman in a brown leather jacket and jeans, seated on a weathered wooden bench against a textured, dark brown and gray wall. The composition features a distinct typographic block on the left side, integrated into the background textures.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject offset to the right to balance the heavy typographic block on the left
Warm skin tones and blonde hair contrasting against cool gray concrete and dark wood
Horizontal lines of the bench and floor boards grounding the verticality of the subject
coreInvariants: Muted, desaturated color palette dominated by browns, grays, and tans
Soft, diffused lighting with minimal harsh shadows
Weathered, distressed textures on all surfaces including the text area

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is seated, occupying the right two-thirds of the frame, medium-full shot scale.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the large slab-serif display text act as dual anchors.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the subject's face, move down the body to the bench, then left to the primary text block.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant dark space above the subject's head and to the far left of the text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm browns and tans (jacket, hair, wood)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with a mid-to-dark value range, creating a vintage, dusty feel.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif and wide sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Display text uses thick, blocky serifs with rounded corners
Secondary text uses a wide, all-caps sans-serif with generous tracking
Text is distressed with a subtle grunge texture overlay
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are slightly weathered to match the background wood grain

composition.relationshipToImage: Placed within a decorative frame on the background wall
Placed on the wooden bench surface

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy slab serif for impact paired with a wide, airy sans-serif for clarity.
graphicDevices: Decorative bracketed frame around the display text
Small star icons flanking the subtitle text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab serif structure and classic country feel
Similar wide, small-serif feel for the secondary text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A high-resolution photograph of a blonde woman in a brown leather jacket and jeans sitting on a rustic wooden bench. The background is a mix of dark brown wood and gray concrete. Muted earth tones, soft lighting, vintage film grain.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a two-line slab-serif title in off-white on the left side, enclosed in a subtle decorative frame. Below it, add a single line of wide sans-serif text flanked by small stars. Apply a light grunge texture to all text.

verificationChecks: Is the text legible despite the distress texture?
Does the subject's position balance the text block?
Is the color palette restricted to muted earth tones?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the wood grain texture
Width of the slab serif font
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Check that the text does not obscure the subject's face
Ensure the decorative frame around the text looks integrated into the wall
Verify the lighting on the text matches the scene's ambient light
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a rustic, textured portrait with a heavy slab-serif typographic block framed by decorative elements, using a muted earth-tone palette.
